hobbies that will make you sharper
than everyone around you

crosswords with coffee

do one crossword or word puzzle with your morning coffee. it wakes up your memory and your vocabulary before the busy day starts asking anything of them.

learning to cook by taste

cook one meal a week without measuring, adjusting only by taste. it trains your attention, your judgment and your patience, all while you make dinner.

a daily lesson

spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson about how the world works: physics, economics, the human body. small daily doses keep your mind sharp long after school ends.
slides.texte_sophia:
a daily lesson

i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson about how the world works: physics, the human body. i do it with the Sophia app, one lesson a day, and it keeps my mind sharp.

slides.texte_overlay:
debating both sides

once a week, pick a topic and argue the side you disagree with, out loud or on paper. understanding the other side is what makes your own opinion actually strong.

birdsong identification

learn to recognise five bird songs near where you live. it trains your ears and your patience, and every walk turns into a small, quiet game of noticing.
